scope: Only the fixed sixteen geometry paints and three clips; independent numeric/frame/primary and both white PDF views are required.

original.scope: Only this independently registered fixture, representation, white background, region and view. No inherited or candidate-derived allowance.
original.rounding: Foreground mean rounded upward to 1e-9; other maxima are the exact independent observation. Absent edges are never allowed for measured-edge regions.

native.scope: Only the fixed sixteen-paint/three-clip native geometric SVG representations against qualified ordinary PDF/Cairo.
native.rounding: Per-view/per-region maxima across exactly eight oracle-only representations; foreground means rounded upward to 1e-9. No additional margin.

instructions.scope: Only this independently registered fixture, representation, white background, region and view. No inherited or candidate-derived allowance.
instructions.rounding: Foreground mean rounded upward to 1e-9; other maxima are the exact independent observation. Absent edges are never allowed for measured-edge regions.
